requirement: The governor module is a DC-SCM-class card: SFF-TA-1002 Type 1 4C+ card edge, 168 pins
notes: No card has been built.

requirement: Every governor pin has a home: a DC-SCI pin, an LTPI channel, the module, its own connector, or an explicit no-public-home flag
notes: 85 governor pins; 4 have no public home (PEX_MDIO, PEX_MDC, DPU_OOB_TX, DPU_OOB_RX).

requirement: No DC-SCI pin is used twice and a multi-function pin carries one function
notes: Planted reuse and wrong-function faults are caught by code.

requirement: Voltage domains match or a translator is named (3.3 V governor I/O onto 3.3 V and 1.8 V DC-SCI I2C)
notes: I2C_3V3_3 to _6 are 3.3 V only on a single-node HPM.

requirement: HPM FRU stays on I2C bus 0
notes: Governor buses start at I2C_3V3_1.

requirement: The governor runs from standby P12V_AUX so its levers are safe before host main power
When the governor module is the DC-SCM in the slot it implements PRSNT0/1, SCM_HPM_STBY_EN, HPM_SCM_STBY_RDY, SCM_HPM_STBY_RST_N and VCC_SCM_HPM_FRU
notes: The power-state sequence of 3.6 is not modelled.

requirement: Per-slot PERST#, PWRBRK# and PWR_EN have no DC-SCI pin and ride LTPI GPIO to HPM logic
notes: DC-SCM puts per-endpoint PERST out of scope. The HPM-side CPLD logic is OEM work; no public source.

requirement: Pin numbers confirmed against the OCP DC-SCI pin spreadsheet itself
notes: The spreadsheet's pin tab would not render through any read path here. Numbers come from the Argus transcription (ARGUS).

requirement: Chassis intrusion from the HPM feeds TAMPER_IN
Governor JTAG, provisioning SPI, REFCLK and RESET_N are never reachable from the HPM
notes: DC-SCI JTAG is SCM-initiator toward the HPM, the opposite role.

requirement: The governor has a reset input for its own PCIe endpoint that never resets the core
notes: Proposed pin +PCIE_EP_PERST_N: missing from hw/pinout/governor_module.csv.

requirement: LTPI2 (OCP bay lane 1 and 3 alternates) belongs to the governor; LTPI stays with the BMC
notes: Keeps the BMC's CPLD out of the lever path. Confirm LTPI2 in the DC-SCM 2.2 spreadsheet.

requirement: Every tunnelled lever fits the LTPI Default I/O Frame (16 LL + 16 NL GPIO per direction)
notes: 24 slot levers + 2 switch resets SCM to HPM; 8 power-good inputs HPM to SCM.

requirement: The power brake rides a low-latency GPIO and the 1 ms halt bound holds with the LTPI hop
notes: 317.15 us loop worst case + 19.20 us LL random latency at 25 MHz SDR = 336.35 us.

requirement: On Link Lost and before first Operational the HPM LTPI endpoint drives every governor lever to asserted
notes: LTPI as written keeps the last GPIO state. Our requirement is stricter than the spec and needs OEM HPM logic.

requirement: The governor has an LTPI endpoint inside its trust boundary
notes: The governor die has no LVDS. Proposed: an on-module FPGA, measured, inside the potted module.

requirement: T_PVPERL: PERST# held at least 100 ms after slot power is valid
notes: Finding: HaltSeq alone releases PERST# on the same edge it raises PWR_EN (test_finding_sequencer_releases_perst_with_power_not_valid). Fixed by rtl/governor_rtl/cem_sideband.py, not yet in GovernorCore.

requirement: T_PERST: PERST# asserted at least 100 us
notes: Finding: HALT then CLEAR then RUN gives a 3-cycle reset (test_finding_sequencer_perst_pulse_shorter_than_t_perst).

requirement: T_FAIL: PERST# asserted within 500 ns of slot power going invalid
notes: Met with a direct power-good input. Not met through an LTPI hop (test_finding_t_fail_cannot_be_met_through_an_ltpi_hop): REQUIREMENT-LOCAL-POWER-FAIL-DRIVES-PERST puts the HPM's own power-fail into PERST#.

requirement: T_PERST-CLK: REFCLK stable 100 us before PERST# release
notes: Board requirement: the governor does not own the slot REFCLK.

requirement: PWRBRK# is an open-drain host output on CEM edge pin B30 with a pull-up on the card
notes: Pin B30 only from secondary sources; the CEM pin table is members-only.

requirement: How fast a GPU slows down after PWRBRK# asserts
notes: CEM text is members-only; NVIDIA's figure is not public. A non-NVIDIA patent (INSPUR) says within 5 ms. Our 1 ms bound is at the pin only.

requirement: The sequencer asserts the brake one clock after a cause (20 ns at 50 MHz), inside the loop's 10 us lever assumption
An undriven PWRBRK# net reads as released (card pull-up), so the HPM endpoint must drive it asserted by default
notes: Covered by REQUIREMENT-LINK-LOSS-ASSERTS-LEVERS.

requirement: A card's WAKE# cannot re-power a slot the governor cut
notes: WAKE# is not a governor signal. Requirement on the platform: WAKE# never overrides PWR_EN.

requirement: The GPU's SMBus post-box (SMBPBI) at 8-bit address 0x9E/0x9F, governor as sole master
notes: The SMBPBI command set is NDA (SMBPBIDG).

requirement: The governor does not depend on the slot's 3.3Vaux
notes: Slot 3.3Vaux budgets are in the members-only CEM; we do not use them.

requirement: A per-slot power-good input reaches the governor (needed for T_PVPERL)
notes: Proposed pin +SLOT_PWRGD, missing from hw/pinout/governor_module.csv.

requirement: CemSideband wired into GovernorCore and proven on the generated Verilog
notes: Left out of top.py so the WAVE-FORMAL-PROOFS-ON-VERILOG halt_seq proofs on the other branches stay valid; next step.

requirement: GET_VERSION / VERSION, 1.1 and 1.2
notes: Validator group 1; libspdm EXPERIMENT-SPDM-INTEROP-EARLIER-VERSION EXPERIMENT-SPDM-INTEROP-RAW-MEASUREMENTS.

requirement: GET_CAPABILITIES, including the requester flag rules and 1.2 transfer sizes
notes: First validator run failed case 2.4 five times (docs/interfaces/results/spdm-validator-run1-before-fix.log); fixed.

requirement: NEGOTIATE_ALGORITHMS: ECDSA P-384, SHA-384, DMTF measurement specification
GET_DIGESTS and GET_CERTIFICATE with the chain format (length, root hash, DER chain)
CHALLENGE / CHALLENGE_AUTH signed over M1 (1.2 signing context)
notes: libspdm rejects a flipped signature bit (interop EXPERIMENT-SPDM-FLIPPED-CHALLENGE-SIGNATURE).

requirement: GET_MEASUREMENTS signed over L1 (VCA prefix at 1.2), digests or raw bit stream
notes: libspdm rejects a flipped signature bit (interop EXPERIMENT-SPDM-FLIPPED-MEASUREMENT-SIGNATURE).

requirement: Measurement blocks are the governor's own registers: meas0, meas1, policy epoch, lifecycle
DICE: DeviceID key from CDI_0, alias key from CDI_1, FWID extension on the alias certificate
CTExponent covers one P-384 signature on the governor (2^15 us >= 17 ms)
DMTF SPDM-Responder-Validator against the governor responder
notes: 781 assertions pass, 0 fail; 48 cases not run (1.0, 1.3, 1.4, sessions, large responses).

requirement: Interop both ways with libspdm (spdm-emu), 1.1 and 1.2, with negative controls
notes: spdm-emu prints NO_AUTHORITY and still exits 0 on an untrusted root (EXPERIMENT-SPDM-REQUESTER-TRUSTS-SAMPLE-ROOT): its exit code alone is not a trust verdict.

requirement: Transport binding: MCTP over SMBus or PCIe DOE
notes: DMTF's binding specs are public but were not read here; only the spdm-emu NONE transport is used.

requirement: SPDM sessions (KEY_EXCHANGE, FINISH, HEARTBEAT, KEY_UPDATE, END_SESSION)
notes: Not implemented.

requirement: Production provisioning CA for the DeviceID certificate
notes: Only a deterministic TEST CA exists.

requirement: Parse NVIDIA's report (SPDM 1.1 GET_MEASUREMENTS request + response, opaque TLVs) the way NVIDIA's verifier does
notes: 64 blocks, FWID, driver and VBIOS fields identical to the nvtrust oracle.

requirement: Certificate chain verified to the pinned NVIDIA device root (device-supplied root replaced)
Report signature ECDSA P-384 / SHA-384 over request and response
Leaf FWID extension equals the report FWID
The report nonce is one the governor issued, used once
notes: The public sample has a fixed nonce, so tests insert it; a replay is refused.

requirement: Golden comparison gives NVIDIA's own answer on NVIDIA's test RIMs
notes: Both say the sample does not match those RIMs, at the same 20 indices.

requirement: RIM XML signatures verified (off-chip, when the policy is built)
notes: NVIDIA's own check fails offline here: the test RIM signing certificate has expired.

requirement: Certificate revocation (OCSP)
notes: The governor has no network; it uses the policy's revocation list. nvtrust's OCSP call failed here (no network).

requirement: GPU debug or CC-mode state from the report
notes: No opaque field is publicly documented as a debug flag.

requirement: A model-manifest digest in the GPU report
notes: The first ask to NVIDIA (docs/03 section 9). Integrated tier refuses NVIDIA reports until it exists.

requirement: Blackwell report and TcbInfo FWID format
notes: nvtrust has a Blackwell branch but the repo ships only a Hopper sample.

requirement: VERIFY_GPU accepts NVIDIA evidence only through a signed policy's reference values
HGX baseboard per-GPU PERST#, power brake and power-enable pin map
notes: Not read. Public record: at most three grouped PERST inputs and one board-level brake (HGXOCP).

notes: Not read. Public: one opcode family in the L40S brief.

notes: Not read.
